reference: bench-src/ref/gen_impactsound.py — independent Python implementation of EN ISO 12354-2:2017 §4.1 Formula (3), §4.3.2 Formula (15), (16), (18), (19), §4.3.3 c), Annex B.2 (B.5), Annex C (C.2)/(C.4)/(C.5), EN ISO 12354-1:2017 Annex B.4 (B.11), Annex E.3.2–E.3.4 and of the EN ISO 717-2:2020 rating, over: the Annex G.1.3 worked example and the rating of the Table G.1 spectrum (printed values as external anchors, 2/2), the presets, a grid of slab mass × floating floor (none, wet, dry, lab) × wall mass and junction (rigid / flexible) × room volume, rooms beside and diagonally below with linings, lab floors and walls, ceiling linings with and without a covering, soft coverings on floating floors, LI,50 from lab values, ΔLw of three floating floors on the reference floor, and the refusals. Cases written from the clauses (r3-fix, R3-REVIEW CR-8..CR-11, CR-32): joints crossed at a flexible junction per EN ISO 12354-1 E.3.4 Figure E.5 / NOTE 4 (K24 along the continuous slab), Cc by load, half ΔRw per §4.3.3 e), the Figure C.1 / C.2 ranges (verdict not determinable outside), the verdict on the 0,1 dB value. Shared reading with the engine: the continuing element at each junction, a floating floor counted as the floor covering of §4.3.3 c)/e), Cc 15 for an unknown load, the larger ΔLw of covering and floating floor, the Belgian value without the soft covering, the f0 > 100 Hz flag

Learning assumptions / interpretations of both engine and reference (labelled on the page): walls of the room below continue through the junction, the slab continues for rooms beside / diagonal; flexible wall: one joint on the corner path, two on the straight path; a soft covering on a floating floor counts as the larger ΔLw
tolerance: ±0,01 dB on L′n,w, L′nT,w (without and with the covering), Ln,eq,0,w, ΔLw, f0, LI,50 and every path value; exact dominant path, f0 flag, refusals, target verdicts and EN ISO 717-2 single numbers; the printed Annex G.1.3 values within ±0,5 dB (L′n,w) and ±0,1 dB (paths), the printed G.1 rating exactly; the page path (preset → state → engine → L′nT,w tile) for every preset case

provenance_note: Expected values were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_impactsound.py, an independent Python implementation of EN ISO 12354-2:2017 §4.1 Formula (3), §4.3.2 Formula (15), (16), (18), (19), §4.3.3 c), Annex B.2 (B.5), Annex C (C.2), (C.4), (C.5), of EN ISO 12354-1:2017 Annex B.4 (B.11) and Annex E.3.2–E.3.4, and of the EN ISO 717-2:2020 rating (Table 3, §4.3, Annex A.2.1, §5 Table 4), written from the rendered norm pages, not from the page code. External anchors: the printed L′n,w = 39,7 dB and the five printed path values of Annex G.1.3 (Table G.10); the printed rating L′n,w (CI; CI,50-2500) = 41 (2; 7) dB of the Table G.1 spectrum. Shared reading with the engine (labelled on the page): the walls of the room below continue through the junction, the slab continues for rooms beside / diagonal, joints crossed at a flexible junction, the larger ΔLw of covering and floating floor, the Belgian value without the soft covering.
